title: SpaceParams
description:
`space.ensure`'s and `space.erase`'s params: the space, by name.

```json
{"name": "default"}
```

name.description:
The space: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, starting with a
letter or digit, with no `..`, no `.` at the end, and not a Windows device name
such as `con` or `nul`.
